packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once CI passes (overnight only)
authentik feature releases are gated by the authentik-breaking-changes CI job
prBodyNotes: If the `authentik-breaking-changes` job fails, read the release notes it prints, then add the `breaking-reviewed` label and start a new pipeline from the MR (MR > Pipelines > Run pipeline). Retrying the failed job keeps the old labels.

packageRules.description: GitLab is never tested in CI or auto-deployed; merge and update it by hand
prBodyNotes: GitLab is excluded from CI and from `deploy.sh`. After merging, update it on the host with `docker compose pull gitlab && docker compose up -d gitlab`.
